sona_p.name: 能量和弦

keySummary.text:
渐入佳音：娑娜在出色地使用她的技能时，会获得非终极技能的技能急速，直到达到上限为止。在达到上限之后，后续的成功使用将转而缩短她终极技能的冷却时间。

能量和弦：每施放若干次技能，娑娜的下次攻击将造成额外魔法伤害并基于最新激活的基础技能施加一个额外效果。

keyTooltip.text:
渐入佳音：娑娜可通过出色地使用她的基础技能来获得【渐入佳音】层数。每层会为她永久提供+%i:scaleAH%@AccelerandoAHPerStack@基础技能急速，至多提供%i:scaleAH% @AccelerandoCap@基础技能急速。当她达到%i:scaleAH% @AccelerandoCap@基础技能急速时，将不再进一步获得层数，转而使她当前的终极技能冷却时间缩短@Spell.SonaPassive:AccelerandoUltCDR@秒。

能量和弦：在使用@PowerChordPassiveCountMax@次基础技能后，娑娜的下次攻击将造成额外的@PowerChordDamage@魔法伤害并会基于娑娜最新激活的乐曲来施加一个额外效果。
  • 英勇赞美诗：该次攻击转而造成@Spell.SonaQ:TotalStaccatoDamage@魔法伤害。
  • 坚毅咏叹调：使目标造成的伤害降低@Spell.SonaW:TotalDiminuendoWeakenPercent@，持续@Spell.SonaW:DiminuendoDuration@秒。
  • 迅捷奏鸣曲：对目标施加持续@Spell.SonaE:TempoDuration@秒的@Spell.SonaE:TotalTempoMoveSpeedSlow@减速。

officialEvidence.name: Power Chord
officialEvidence.description:
Accelerando: Sona gains non-Ultimate ability haste permanently for her basic abilities as she uses her abilities well, up to a cap. Beyond that cap, further successful uses reduce her ultimate's remaining cooldown instead.

Power Chord: Every few spell casts, Sona's next attack will deal bonus magic damage in addition to an additional effect based on what basic Ability Sona last activated.
relevantEnemyTips: Spread out when you see Sona so she can't make your entire team dance.
Kill Sona first, as she will heal up her team if left alone for too long.
